gloss: a fleeing rabbit (脱兎のごとく, like a shot)

definitions.gloss: a fleeing rabbit; (in 脱兎のごとく) like a shot, at full speed
definitions.explanation: Literally a rabbit running away. Used almost only in the set phrase {脱兎|だっと}のごとく, 'like a fleeing rabbit', for running off very fast.

examples.japanese: {脱兎|だっと}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ごとく⟦{逃|に}げる→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧。
examples.english: To run off like a shot.

examples.japanese: ⟦ベル→ベル：01379_beru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}る→鳴る：01143_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{脱兎|だっと}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ごとく⟦{教室|きょうしつ}→教室：00794_kyoushitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飛|と}び{出|だ}した→飛び出す：02374_tobidasu⟧。
examples.english: When the bell rang, he dashed out of the classroom like a shot.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警官|けいかん}→警官：02876_keikan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{途端|とたん}→途端：03462_totan⟧、⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{脱兎|だっと}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ごとく⟦{走|はし}り{去|さ}った→走り去る：18596_hashirisaru⟧。
examples.english: The moment he saw the police officer, the man took off at full speed.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {脱兎|だっと}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ごとく: like a fleeing rabbit; at lightning speed
- {始|はじ}め⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{処女|しょじょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ごとく、⟦{後|のち}→後：03545_nochi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{脱兎|だっと}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ごとし: from Sunzi's Art of War, 'first shy as a maiden, then swift as a fleeing hare' (lull the enemy, then strike fast)

REGISTER:
Written and literary; in speech people say ものすごい⟦{速|はや}さ→速さ：28072_hayasa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{逃|に}げた→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧ or ⟦{一目散|いちもくさん}→一目散：08954_ichimokusan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{逃|に}げた→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧.
